notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
description:
Cast Massimo by paying its mana cost plus commander tax if applicable
When Massimo enters, it triggers, exiling Splash Portal from your graveyard and giving Massimo the listed ability.
Move to your next turn. Optionally, you can instead give Massimo haste.
Declare Massimo and Aurelia as attackers.
Aurelia triggers, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage with Massimo. Its ability triggers, casting a copy of Splash Portal from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Splash Portal, blinking Aurelia.
Repeat from step 4 each combat phase.
